Souvlaki and meze · Iroon 13, Omorfita

Souvlaki and meze in Omorfita

A tavern at the Omorfita association in Nicosia, open in the evening from Tuesday to Saturday. On Google, 4.8 stars from 45 reviews.

Food

What comes to the table

From the tavern’s Facebook page and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meze

Guests write about generous meze with plenty of meat. One guest paid 20 € per person and calls it very rich.

Souvlaki

In pita or on the plate, with salad. One guest calls the souvlaki really well cooked.

Kleftiko on Thursdays

The Facebook page announces kleftiko every Thursday, to take away or delivered.

Music on Friday

Guests write about live music on Friday evenings.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Hospitable

Guests describe warm owners and staff, and say you feel at home.

Generous portions

Portion sizes come up again and again, with a lot of food on the table.

Fair prices

One guest praises affordable, down to earth prices.

At the Omorfita association

The tavern is on Iroon street in Omorfita, at the Omorfita association, as its sign says. Guests describe a quiet and simple place, and one guest writes that there is also a little church and a playground for children.

What guests say

Three of 45 Google reviews, 40 of them with five stars.

«Εύγευστο, ποιοτικό, καλό ψημένο φαγητό. Πήραμε μεζέδες 20 ευρώ τό άτομο αλλά πολύ πλούσιο! Αξίζει να πας! Ήσυχος καί απλός χώρος. Σύλλογος Ομορφιτας!»

Translation: “Tasty, quality, well cooked food. We had meze at 20 euros per person, but very rich! Worth going! A quiet and simple place. Omorfita association!”

Google review
«Οικογενειακή ταβέρνα από απλούς και τίμιους ανθρώπους με μπόλικο και νόστιμο φαγητό, όταν είσαι μερακλής φαίνεται στο τραπέζι …»

Translation: “A family tavern run by simple, honest people, with plenty of tasty food; when you cook with passion, it shows on the table …”

Google review
«Πολύ καλη εξυπηρέτηση και το φαγητό νόστιμο»

Translation: “Very good service and the food is tasty”
